stem: According to the selection, why was it not surprising that younger athletes were the first to use the Fosbury Flop?

options.label: F
options.text: Younger athletes were less afraid to use the “scissors” approach.

options.label: G
options.text: Older athletes were already committed to the established style of high jumping.

options.label: H
options.text: Successful high jumpers were convinced the Fosbury Flop wouldn’t result in higher jumps.

options.label: J
options.text: It is human nature to resist change.
